hrt.description: whether subject had hormone replacement theraphy, and if yes start date

humidity.name: humidity
humidity.description: amount of water vapour in the air, at the time of sampling

humidity_regm.name: humidity_regm
humidity_regm.description: information about treatment involving an exposure to varying degree of humidity; information about treatment involving use of growth hormones; should include amount of humidity administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple regimens

hygienic_area.name: hygienic_area
hygienic_area.description: The subdivision of areas within a food production facility according to hygienic requirements. This field accepts terms listed under hygienic food production area (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO). Please add a term that most accurately indicates the hygienic area your sample was taken from according to the definitions provided

hysterectomy.name: hysterectomy
hysterectomy.description: specification of whether hysterectomy was performed

identified_by.name: identified_by
identified_by.description: name of the taxonomist who identified the specimen

ifsac_category.name: ifsac_category
ifsac_category.description: The IFSAC food categorization scheme has five distinct levels to which foods can be assigned, depending upon the type of food. First, foods are assigned to one of four food groups (aquatic animals, land animals, plants, and other). Food groups include increasingly specific food categories; dairy, eggs, meat and poultry, and game are in the land animal food group, and the category meat and poultry is further subdivided into more specific categories of meat (beef, pork, other meat) and poultry (chicken, turkey, other poultry). Finally, foods are differentiated by differences in food processing (such as pasteurized fluid dairy products, unpasteurized fluid dairy products, pasteurized solid and semi-solid dairy products, and unpasteurized solid and semi-solid dairy products. An IFSAC food category chart is available from https://www.cdc.gov/foodsafety/ifsac/projects/food-categorization-scheme.html PMID: 28926300, e.g., Plants:Produce:Vegetables:Herbs:Dried Herbs

indoor_surf.name: indoor_surf
indoor_surf.description: Type of indoor surface. Enter one of the controlled terms.

indust_eff_percent.name: indust_eff_percent
indust_eff_percent.description: percentage of industrial effluents received by wastewater treatment plant

infra_specific_name.name: infra_specific_name
infra_specific_name.description: taxonomic information about the host below subspecies level

infra_specific_rank.name: infra_specific_rank
infra_specific_rank.description: taxonomic rank information about the host below subspecies level, such as variety, form, rank etc.

inorg_particles.name: inorg_particles
inorg_particles.description: concentration of particles such as sand, grit, metal particles, ceramics, etc.; can include multiple particles

inside_lux.name: inside_lux
inside_lux.description: The recorded value at sampling time (power density)

int_wall_cond.name: int_wall_cond
int_wall_cond.description: The physical condition of the wall at the time of sampling, e.g., new, visible wear, needs repair, damaged, rupture

intended_consumer.name: intended_consumer
intended_consumer.description: Food consumer type, human or animal, for which the food product is produced and marketed, e.g., human

investigation_type.name: investigation_type
investigation_type.description: Nucleic Acid Sequence Report is the root element of all MIGS/MIMS compliant reports as standardized by Genomic Standards Consortium. This field is either eukaryote,bacteria,virus,plasmid,organelle, metagenome, miens-survey or miens-culture Enter one of the controlled terms.

iw_bt_date_well.name: iw_bt_date_well
iw_bt_date_well.description: Injection water breakthrough date per well following a secondary and/or tertiary recovery

iwf.name: iwf
iwf.description: Proportion of the produced fluids derived from injected water at the time of sampling, e.g., 87%

kidney_disord.name: kidney_disord
kidney_disord.description: history of kidney disorders; can include multiple disorders

label.name: label
label.description: A label for sample, or name of an individual animal (e.g., Clint)

last_clean.name: last_clean
last_clean.description: The last time the floor was cleaned (swept, mopped, vacuumed)

last_meal.name: last_meal
last_meal.description: content of last meal and time since feeding; can include multiple values

life_stage.name: life_stage
life_stage.description: description of life stage of host

light_regm.name: light_regm
light_regm.description: Information about treatment(s) involving exposure to light, including both light intensity and quality

link_class_info.name: link_class_info
link_class_info.description: link to digitized soil maps or other soil classification information

lithology.name: lithology
lithology.description: Hydrocarbon resource main lithology, e.g., basement, chalk, chert, coal, conglomerate, diatomite, dolomite, limestone, sandstone, shale, siltstone, volcanic

liver_disord.name: liver_disord
liver_disord.description: history of liver disorders; can include multiple disorders

local_class.name: local_class
local_class.description: soil classification based on local soil classification system

local_class_meth.name: local_class_meth
local_class_meth.description: reference or method used in determining the local soil classification

lot_number.name: lot_number
lot_number.description: A distinctive alpha-numeric identification code assigned by the manufacturer or distributor to a specific quantity of manufactured material or product within a batch. The submitter should provide lot number of the item followed by the item name for which the lot number was provided

maternal_health_stat.name: maternal_health_stat
maternal_health_stat.description: specification of the maternal health status

max_occup.name: max_occup
max_occup.description: The maximum amount of people allowed in the indoor environment

mean_peak_frict_vel.name: mean_peak_frict_vel
mean_peak_frict_vel.description: measurement of mean peak friction velocity

mech_struc.name: mech_struc
mech_struc.description: Mechanical structure: a moving structure, e.g., subway, coach, carriage, elevator, escalator, boat, train, car, bus

mechanical_damage.name: mechanical_damage
mechanical_damage.description: information about any mechanical damage exerted on the plant; can include multiple damages and sites

medic_hist_perform.name: medic_hist_perform
medic_hist_perform.description: whether full medical history was collected

methane.name: methane
methane.description: methane (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling

microb_cult_med.name: microb_cult_med
microb_cult_med.description: A culture medium used to select for, grow, and maintain prokaryotic microorganisms. Can be in either liquid (broth) or solidified (e.g. with agar) forms. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium. If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the culture medium

microb_start.name: microb_start
microb_start.description: Any type of microorganisms used in food production. This field accepts terms listed under live organisms for food production (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_0344453)

microb_start_count.name: microb_start_count
microb_start_count.description: Total cell count of starter culture per gram, volume or area of sample and the method that was used for the enumeration (e.g. qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) should also be provided, e.g., total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qPCR

microb_start_inoc.name: microb_start_inoc
microb_start_inoc.description: The amount of starter culture used to inoculate a new batch

microb_start_prep.name: microb_start_prep
microb_start_prep.description: Information about the protocol or method used to prepare the starter inoculum

microb_start_source.name: microb_start_source
microb_start_source.description: The source from which the microbial starter culture was sourced. If commercially supplied, list supplier

microb_start_taxid.name: microb_start_taxid
microb_start_taxid.description: Please include Genus species and strain ID, if known of microorganisms used in food production. For complex communities, pipes can be used to separate two or more microbes

microbial_biomass.name: microbial_biomass
microbial_biomass.description: the part of the organic matter in the soil that constitutes living microorganisms smaller than 5-10 micrometers. IF you keep this, you would need to have correction factors used for conversion to the final units, which should be mg C (or N)/kg soil).

microbial_biomass_meth.name: microbial_biomass_meth
microbial_biomass_meth.description: reference or method used in determining microbial biomass

mineral_nutr_regm.name: mineral_nutr_regm
mineral_nutr_regm.description: information about treatment involving the use of mineral supplements; should include the name of mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple mineral nutrient regimens

misc_param.name: misc_param
misc_param.description: any other measurement performed or parameter collected, that is not listed here

mode_transmission.name: mode_transmission
mode_transmission.description: The process through which the symbiotic host organism entered the host from which it was sampled, e.g., horizontal:castrator, horizontal:directly transmitted, horizontal:micropredator, horizontal:parasitoid, horizontal:trophically transmitted, horizontal:vector transmitted, vertical

molecular_data_type.name: molecular_data_type
molecular_data_type.description: Type of molecular (omics) data tied to this sample

n_alkanes.name: n_alkanes
n_alkanes.description: concentration of n-alkanes; can include multiple n-alkanes

narms_isolate_number.name: narms_isolate_number
narms_isolate_number.description: isolate identifier for the collection of isolates in the National Antimicrobial Resistance Monitoring System, authority http://www.cdc.gov/narms/about/index.html, e.g., CVM N6429

neg_cont_type.name: neg_cont_type
neg_cont_type.description: The substance or equipment used as a negative control in an investigation, e.g., distilled water, phosphate buffer, empty collection device, empty collection tube, DNA-free PCR mix, sterile swab, sterile syringe

non_mineral_nutr_regm.name: non_mineral_nutr_regm
non_mineral_nutr_regm.description: information about treatment involving the exposure of plant to non-mineral nutrient such as oxygen, hydrogen or carbon; should include the name of non-mineral nutrient, amount administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple non-mineral nutrient regimens

nose_mouth_teeth_throat_disord.name: nose_mouth_teeth_throat_disord
nose_mouth_teeth_throat_disord.description: history of nose/mouth/teeth/throat disorders; can include multiple disorders

nose_throat_disord.name: nose_throat_disord
nose_throat_disord.description: history of nose-throat disorders; can include multiple disorders

num_samp_collect.name: num_samp_collect
num_samp_collect.description: The number of samples collected during the current sampling event

number_pets.name: number_pets
number_pets.description: The number of pets residing in the sampled space

number_plants.name: number_plants
number_plants.description: The number of plant(s) in the sampling space

number_resident.name: number_resident
number_resident.description: The number of individuals currently occupying in the sampling location

occup_document.name: occup_document
occup_document.description: The type of documentation of occupancy, e.g., automated count, estimate, manual count, videos

occupation.name: occupation
occupation.description: most frequent job performed by subject

omics_observ_id.name: omics_observ_id
omics_observ_id.description: A unique identifier of the omics-enabled observatory (or comparable time series) your data derives from. This identifier should be provided by the OMICON ontology; if you require a new identifier for your time series, contact the ontology's developers. Information is available here: https://github.com/GLOMICON/omicon. This field is only applicable to records which derive from an omics time-series or observatory.

org_count_qpcr_info.name: org_count_qpcr_info
org_count_qpcr_info.description: If qpcr was used for the cell count, the target gene name, the primer sequence and the cycling conditions should also be provided, e.g., 16S rrna; FWD:ACGTAGCTATGACGT REV:GTGCTAGTCGAGTAC; initial denaturation:90C_5min; denaturation:90C_2min; annealing:52C_30 sec; elongation:72C_30 sec; 90 C for 1 min; final elongation:72C_5min; 30 cycles

org_particles.name: org_particles
org_particles.description: concentration of particles such as faeces, hairs, food, vomit, paper fibers, plant material, humus, etc.

outbreak.name: outbreak
outbreak.description: Submitter designated name for an occurrence of more cases of disease than expected in a given area or among a specific group of people over a particular period of time.

owc_tvdss.name: owc_tvdss
owc_tvdss.description: Depth of the original oil water contact (OWC) zone (average) (m TVDSS)

oxygen.name: oxygen
oxygen.description: oxygen (gas) amount or concentration at the time of sampling

part_plant_animal.name: part_plant_animal
part_plant_animal.description: The anatomical part of the organism being involved in food production or consumption; e.g., a carrot is the root of the plant (root vegetable). This field accepts terms listed under part of plant or animal (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03420116)

particle_class.name: particle_class
particle_class.description: particles are classified, based on their size, into six general categories: clay, silt, sand, gravel, cobbles, and boulders; should include amount of particle preceded by the name of the particle type; can include multiple values

passage_history.name: passage_history
passage_history.description: Number of passages and passage method

passage_method.name: passage_method
passage_method.description: Description of how the organism was passaged. Provide a short description, e.g., AVL buffer+30%EtOH lysate received from Respiratory Lab. P3 passage in Vero-1 via bioreactor large-scale batch passage. P3 batch derived from the SP-2/reference lab strain. If not passaged, put ""not applicable"".

passage_number.name: passage_number
passage_number.description: The number of known passages, e.g., 3. If not passaged, put ""not applicable"".

pathogenicity.name: pathogenicity
pathogenicity.description: To what is the entity pathogenic

pathotype.name: pathotype
pathotype.description: Some bacterial specific pathotypes (example Eschericia coli - STEC, UPEC)

pathovar.name: pathovar
pathovar.description: Taxonomy below subspecies; a variety (in bacteria, fungi or virus) usually based on its pathogenic properties. Sometimes used as equivalent to subspecies.

permeability.name: permeability
permeability.description: Measure of the ability of a hydrocarbon resource to allow fluids to pass through it. Additional information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Permeability_(earth_sciences)

perturbation.name: perturbation
perturbation.description: type of perturbation, e.g. chemical administration, physical disturbance, etc., coupled with time that perturbation occurred; can include multiple perturbation types

pesticide_regm.name: pesticide_regm
pesticide_regm.description: information about treatment involving use of insecticides; should include the name of pesticide, amount administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple pesticide regimens

pet_farm_animal.name: pet_farm_animal
synonyms: presence of pets or farm animals
pet_farm_animal.description: specification of presence of pets or farm animals in the environment of subject, if yes the animals should be specified; can include multiple animals present

ph_meth.name: ph_meth
ph_meth.description: reference or method used in determining pH

ph_regm.name: ph_regm
ph_regm.description: information about treatment involving exposure of plants to varying levels of pH of the growth media; can include multiple regimen

phaeopigments.name: phaeopigments
phaeopigments.description: concentration of phaeopigments; can include multiple phaeopigments

phenotype.name: phenotype
phenotype.description: Phenotype of sampled organism. For Phenotypic quality Ontology (PATO) (v1.269) terms.

phosplipid_fatt_acid.name: phosplipid_fatt_acid
phosplipid_fatt_acid.description: concentration of phospholipid fatty acids; can include multiple values

photosynt_activ.name: photosynt_activ
photosynt_activ.description: Measurement of photosythetic activity (i.e. leaf gas exchange / chlorophyll fluorescence emissions / reflectance / transpiration) Please also include the term method term detailing the method of activity measurement

photosynt_activ_meth.name: photosynt_activ_meth
photosynt_activ_meth.description: Reference or method used in measurement of photosythetic activity

plant_body_site.name: plant_body_site
plant_body_site.description: Name of body site that the sample was obtained from. For PO (v819) terms.

plant_growth_med.name: plant_growth_med
plant_growth_med.description: Type of the media used for growing sampled plants, e.g., soil [ENVO:00001998]

plant_part_maturity.name: plant_part_maturity
plant_part_maturity.description: A description of the stage of development of a plant or plant part based on maturity or ripeness. This field accepts terms listed under degree of plant maturity (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/FOODON_03530050)

plant_product.name: plant_product
plant_product.description: substance produced by the plant, where the sample was obtained from

plant_reprod_crop.name: plant_reprod_crop
plant_reprod_crop.description: Plant reproductive part used in the field during planting to start the crop, e.g., plant cutting, pregerminated seed, ratoon, seed, seedling, whole mature plant

plant_sex.name: plant_sex
plant_sex.description: Sex of the reproductive parts on the whole plant, e.g., androdioecious, androecious, androgynous, androgynomonoecious, andromonoecious, bisexual, dichogamous, diclinous, dioecious, gynodioecious, gynoecious, gynomonoecious, hermaphroditic, imperfect, monoclinous, monoecious, perfect, polygamodioecious, polygamomonoecious, polygamous, protandrous, protogynous, subandroecious, subdioecious, subgynoecious, synoecious, trimonoecious, trioecious, unisexual

plant_struc.name: plant_struc
plant_struc.description: Name of plant structure the sample was obtained from; for Plant Ontology (PO) (v releases/2017-12-14) terms, see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/PO, e.g., petiole epidermis (PO_0000051). If an individual flower is sampled, the sex of it can be recorded here

plant_water_method.name: plant_water_method
plant_water_method.description: Description of the equipment or method used to distribute water to crops. This field encourages terms listed under irrigation process (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/AGRO_00000006). Multiple terms can be separated by pipes, e.g., drip irrigation process [AGRO:00000056]

ploidy.name: ploidy
ploidy.description: The ploidy level of the genome (e.g. allopolyploid, haploid, diploid, triploid, tetraploid).

pollutants.name: pollutants
pollutants.description: pollutant types and, amount or concentrations measured at the time of sampling; can report multiple pollutants by entering numeric values preceded by name of pollutant

pool_dna_extracts.name: pool_dna_extracts
pool_dna_extracts.description: were multiple DNA extractions mixed? how many?

population.name: population
population.description: for human: ; for plants: filial generation, number of progeny, genetic structure

population_description.name: population_description
population_description.description: The full, unabbreviated population descriptor from the Coriell Institute

porosity.name: porosity
porosity.description: porosity of deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample

pos_cont_type.name: pos_cont_type
pos_cont_type.description: The substance, mixture, product, or apparatus used to verify that a process which is part of an investigation delivers a true positive

pour_point.name: pour_point
pour_point.description: Temperature at which a liquid becomes semi solid and loses its flow characteristics. In crude oil a high pour point is generally associated with a high paraffin content, typically found in crude deriving from a larger proportion of plant material (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/pour_point)

pre_treatment.name: pre_treatment
pre_treatment.description: the process of pre-treatment removes materials that can be easily collected from the raw wastewater

pres_animal_insect.name: pres_animal_insect
pres_animal_insect.description: The type and number of animals or insects present in the sampling space, e.g., cat 10, dog 2, rodent 100, snake 1

pressure.name: pressure
pressure.description: pressure to which the sample is subject, in atmospheres

previous_land_use_meth.name: previous_land_use_meth
previous_land_use_meth.description: reference or method used in determining previous land use and dates

primary_treatment.name: primary_treatment
primary_treatment.description: the process to produce both a generally homogeneous liquid capable of being treated biologically and a sludge that can be separately treated or processed

prior_sars_cov_2_antiviral_treat.name: prior_sars_cov_2_antiviral_treat
prior_sars_cov_2_antiviral_treat.description: Has the host received SARS-CoV-2 antiviral treatment?

prior_sars_cov_2_infection.name: prior_sars_cov_2_infection
prior_sars_cov_2_infection.description: Did the host have a prior SARS-CoV-2 infection?

prior_sars_cov_2_vaccination.name: prior_sars_cov_2_vaccination
prior_sars_cov_2_vaccination.description: Has the host received a SARS-CoV-2 vaccination?

prod_label_claims.name: prod_label_claims
prod_label_claims.description: Labeling claims containing descriptors such as wild caught, free-range, organic, free-range, industrial, hormone-free, antibiotic free, cage free

prod_rate.name: prod_rate
prod_rate.description: Oil and/or gas production rates per well, e.g., 524 m3/day

profile_position.name: profile_position
profile_position.description: Cross-sectional position in the hillslope where sample was collected, sample area position in relation to surrounding areas. Enter one of the controlled terms.

project_name.name: project_name
project_name.description: A concise name that describes the overall project, for example "Analysis of sequences collected from Antarctic soil"

pulmonary_disord.name: pulmonary_disord
pulmonary_disord.description: history of pulmonary disorders; can include multiple disorders

pulse.name: pulse
pulse.description: resting pulse, measured as beats per minute

purpose_of_sampling.name: purpose_of_sampling
purpose_of_sampling.description: The reason the sample was collected, e.g., diagnostic testing

purpose_of_sequencing.name: purpose_of_sequencing
purpose_of_sequencing.description: The reason the sample was sequenced, e.g., baseline surveillance (random sampling)

purpose_of_ww_sampling.name: purpose_of_ww_sampling
purpose_of_ww_sampling.description: The reason the sample was collected

purpose_of_ww_sequencing.name: purpose_of_ww_sequencing
purpose_of_ww_sequencing.description: The reason the sample was sequenced, e.g., identification of mutations within a specific region, presence of clinically known mutations, or diversity of mutations across entire genome

quad_pos.name: quad_pos
quad_pos.description: The quadrant position of the sampling room within the building, e.g., north side, west side, south side, east side

radiation_regm.name: radiation_regm
radiation_regm.description: information about treatment involving exposure of plant or a plant part to a particular radiation regimen; should include the radiation type, amount or intensity administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple radiation regimens

rainfall_regm.name: rainfall_regm
rainfall_regm.description: information about treatment involving an exposure to a given amount of rainfall; can include multiple regimens

reactor_type.name: reactor_type
reactor_type.description: anaerobic digesters can be designed and engineered to operate using a number of different process configurations, as batch or continuous, mesophilic, high solid or low solid, and single stage or multistage

redox_potential.name: redox_potential
redox_potential.description: redox potential, measured relative to a hydrogen cell, indicating oxidation or reduction potential

reference_material.name: reference_material
reference_material.description: Indicates that a standards body or external group asserts this sample is reference material, eg, 'NIST reference material for genome sequencing validation'.

rel_humidity_out.name: rel_humidity_out
rel_humidity_out.description: The recorded outside relative humidity value at the time of sampling

rel_location.name: rel_location
rel_location.description: Location of sample to other parts of the farm, e.g. under crop plant, near irrigation ditch, from the dirt road, from air above crops, nearby river, e.g., furrow

rel_samp_loc.name: rel_samp_loc
rel_samp_loc.description: The sampling location within the train car, e.g., edge of car, center of car, under a seat

rel_to_oxygen.name: rel_to_oxygen
rel_to_oxygen.description: Aerobic or anaerobic. Enter one of the controlled terms.

reservoir_name.name: reservoir_name
reservoir_name.description: Name of the reservoir, e.g., Carapebus

resins_pc.name: resins_pc
resins_pc.description: Saturate, Aromatic, Resin and Asphaltene (SARA) is an analysis method that divides crude oil components according to their polarizability and polarity. There are three main methods to obtain SARA results. The most popular one is known as the Iatroscan TLC-FID and is referred to as IP-143 (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturate,_aromatic,_resin_and_asphaltene)

resp_part_matter.name: resp_part_matter
resp_part_matter.description: concentration of substances that remain suspended in the air, and comprise mixtures of organic and inorganic substances (PM10 and PM2.5); can report multiple PM's by entering numeric values preceded by name of PM

room_air_exch_rate.name: room_air_exch_rate
room_air_exch_rate.description: The rate at which outside air replaces indoor air in a given space

room_architec_elem.name: room_architec_elem
room_architec_elem.description: The unique details and component parts that, together, form the architecture of a distinguisahable space within a built structure

room_condt.name: room_condt
room_condt.description: The condition of the room at the time of sampling, e.g., new, visible wear, needs repair, damaged, rupture, visible signs of mold/mildew

room_connected.name: room_connected
room_connected.description: List of rooms connected to the sampling room by a doorway, e.g., attic, bathroom, closet, conference room, elevator, examining room, hallway, kitchen, mail room, office, stairwell

room_count.name: room_count
room_count.description: The total count of rooms in the built structure including all room types

room_dim.name: room_dim
room_dim.description: The length, width and height of sampling room

room_door_dist.name: room_door_dist
room_door_dist.description: Distance between doors (meters) in the hallway between the sampling room and adjacent rooms

room_door_share.name: room_door_share
room_door_share.description: List of room(s) (room number, room name) sharing a door with the sampling room

room_hallway.name: room_hallway
room_hallway.description: List of room(s) (room number, room name) located in the same hallway as sampling room

room_loc.name: room_loc
room_loc.description: The position of the room within the building, e.g., corner room, interior room, exterior wall

room_moist_dam_hist.name: room_moist_dam_hist
room_moist_dam_hist.description: The history of moisture damage or mold in the past 12 months. Number of events of moisture damage or mold observed

room_net_area.name: room_net_area
room_net_area.description: The net floor area of sampling room. Net area excludes wall thicknesses

room_occup.name: room_occup
room_occup.description: Count of room occupancy at time of sampling

room_samp_pos.name: room_samp_pos
room_samp_pos.description: The horizontal sampling position in the room relative to architectural elements, e.g., north corner, south corner, west corner, east corner, northeast corner, northwest corner, southeast corner, southwest corner, center

room_type.name: room_type
room_type.description: The main purpose or activity of the sampling room. A room is any distinguishable space within a structure, e.g., attic, bathroom, closet, conference room, elevator, examining room, hallway, kitchen, mail room, private office, open office, stairwell,restroom, lobby, vestibule, mechanical or electrical room, data center, laboratory_wet, laboratory_dry, gymnasium, natatorium, auditorium, lockers, cafe, warehouse

room_wall_share.name: room_wall_share
room_wall_share.description: List of room(s) (room number, room name) sharing a wall with the sampling room

room_window_count.name: room_window_count
room_window_count.description: Number of windows in the room

root_cond.name: root_cond
root_cond.description: Relevant rooting conditions such as field plot size, sowing density, container dimensions, number of plants per container

root_med_carbon.name: root_med_carbon
root_med_carbon.description: Source of organic carbon in the culture rooting medium, e.g., sucrose

root_med_macronutr.name: root_med_macronutr
root_med_macronutr.description: Measurement of the culture rooting medium macronutrients (N,P, K, Ca, Mg, S), e.g., KH2PO4 (170mg/L)

root_med_micronutr.name: root_med_micronutr
root_med_micronutr.description: Measurement of the culture rooting medium micronutrients (Fe, Mn, Zn, B, Cu, Mo), e.g., H3BO3 (6.2mg/L)

root_med_ph.name: root_med_ph
root_med_ph.description: pH measurement of the culture rooting medium, e.g., 5.5

root_med_regl.name: root_med_regl
root_med_regl.description: Growth regulators in the culture rooting medium such as cytokinins, auxins, gybberellins, abscisic acid, e.g., 0.5 mg/L NAA

root_med_solid.name: root_med_solid
root_med_solid.description: Specification of the solidifying agent in the culture rooting medium, e.g., agar

root_med_suppl.name: root_med_suppl
root_med_suppl.description: Organic supplements of the culture rooting medium, such as vitamins, amino acids, organic acids, antibiotics activated charcoal, e.g., nicotinic acid (0.5 mg/L)

route_transmission.name: route_transmission
route_transmission.description: Description of path taken by the symbiotic host organism being sampled in order to establish a symbiotic relationship with the host (with which it was observed at the time of sampling) via a mode of transmission (specified in mode_transmission), e.g., environmental:faecal-oral, transplacental, vector-borne:vector penetration

salinity_meth.name: salinity_meth
salinity_meth.description: reference or method used in determining salinity

salt_regm.name: salt_regm
salt_regm.description: information about treatment involving use of salts as supplement to liquid and soil growth media; should include the name of salt, amount administered, treatment duration, interval and total experimental duration; can include multiple salt regimens

same_as.name: same_as
same_as.description: indicates that the same physical sample has multiple BioSample records

samp_capt_status.name: samp_capt_status
samp_capt_status.description: Reason for the sample, e.g., active surveillance in response to an outbreak, active surveillance not initiated by an outbreak, farm sample, market sample

samp_collect_device.name: samp_collect_device
samp_collect_device.description: Method or device employed for collecting sample

samp_collect_method.name: samp_collect_method
samp_collect_method.description: The method employed for collecting the sample

samp_collect_point.name: samp_collect_point
samp_collect_point.description: Sampling point on the asset where sample was collected, e.g., well, test well, drilling rig, wellhead, separator, storage tank

samp_dis_stage.name: samp_dis_stage
samp_dis_stage.description: Stage of the disease at the time of sample collection, e.g., dissemination, growth and reproduction, infection, inoculation, penetration

samp_floor.name: samp_floor
samp_floor.description: The floor of the building, where the sampling room is located, e.g., 1st floor, 2nd floor, basement, lobby

samp_loc_condition.name: samp_loc_condition
samp_loc_condition.description: The condition of the sample location at the time of sampling, e.g., damaged, new, rupture, visible signs of mold-mildew, visible weariness repair

samp_loc_corr_rate.name: samp_loc_corr_rate
samp_loc_corr_rate.description: Metal corrosion rate is the speed of metal deterioration due to environmental conditions. As environmental conditions change corrosion rates change accordingly. Therefore, long term corrosion rates are generally more informative than short term rates and for that reason they are preferred during reporting. In the case of suspected MIC, corrosion rate measurements at the time of sampling might provide insights into the involvement of certain microbial community members in MIC as well as potential microbial interplays

samp_mat_process.name: samp_mat_process
samp_mat_process.description: Processing applied to the sample during or after isolation

samp_mat_type.name: samp_mat_type
samp_mat_type.description: The type of material from which the sample was obtained. For the Hydrocarbon package, samples include types like core, rock trimmings, drill cuttings, piping section, coupon, pigging debris, solid deposit, produced fluid, produced water, injected water, swabs, etc. For the Food Package, samples are usually categorized as food, body products or tissues, or environmental material. This field accepts terms listed under environmental specimen (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0001246)

samp_md.name: samp_md
samp_md.description: In non deviated well, measured depth is equal to the true vertical depth, TVD (TVD=TVDSS plus the reference or datum it refers to). In deviated wells, the MD is the length of trajectory of the borehole measured from the same reference or datum. Common datums used are ground level (GL), drilling rig floor (DF), rotary table (RT), kelly bushing (KB) and mean sea level (MSL). If "other" is specified, please propose entry in "additional info" field

samp_pooling.name: samp_pooling
samp_pooling.description: Physical combination of several instances of like material, e.g., RNA extracted from samples or dishes of cell cultures into one big aliquot of cells. Please provide a short description of the samples that were pooled

samp_preserv.name: samp_preserv
samp_preserv.description: Preservative added to the sample, e.g. Rnalater, alcohol, formaldehyde. Where appropriate include volume added, e.g. Rnalater; 2 ml

samp_rep_biol.name: samp_rep_biol
samp_rep_biol.description: Measurements of biologically distinct samples that show biological variation

samp_rep_tech.name: samp_rep_tech
samp_rep_tech.description: Repeated measurements of the same sample that show independent measures of the noise associated with the equipment and the protocols

samp_room_id.name: samp_room_id
samp_room_id.description: Sampling room number. This ID should be consistent with the designations on the building floor plans

samp_salinity.name: samp_salinity
samp_salinity.description: salinity of sample, i.e. measure of total salt concentration

samp_size.name: samp_size
samp_size.description: Amount or size of sample (volume, mass or area) that was collected

samp_sort_meth.name: samp_sort_meth
samp_sort_meth.description: method by which samples are sorted

samp_source_mat_cat.name: samp_source_mat_cat
samp_source_mat_cat.description: This is the scientific role or category that the subject organism or material has with respect to an investigation. This field accepts terms listed under specimen source material category (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0001237 or http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0100051)

samp_stor_device.name: samp_stor_device
samp_stor_device.description: The container used to store the sample. This field accepts terms listed under container. If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the storage device

samp_stor_media.name: samp_stor_media
samp_stor_media.description: The liquid that is added to the sample collection device prior to sampling. If the sample is pre-hydrated, indicate the liquid media the sample is pre-hydrated with for storage purposes. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MICRO_0000067). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the sample storage media

samp_store_dur.name: samp_store_dur
samp_store_dur.description: duration for which sample was stored

samp_store_loc.name: samp_store_loc
samp_store_loc.description: location at which sample was stored, usually name of a specific freezer/room

samp_store_sol.name: samp_store_sol
samp_store_sol.description: Solution within which sample was stored, if any

samp_store_temp.name: samp_store_temp
samp_store_temp.description: temperature at which sample was stored, e.g. -80

samp_subtype.name: samp_subtype
samp_subtype.description: Name of sample sub-type, e.g., oil phase, water phase, biofilm, not applicable

samp_surf_moisture.name: samp_surf_moisture
samp_surf_moisture.description: Degree of water held on a sampled surface, e.g., intermittent moisture, not present, submerged

samp_time_out.name: samp_time_out
samp_time_out.description: The recent and long term history of outside sampling

samp_transport_cond.name: samp_transport_cond
samp_transport_cond.description: Sample transport duration (in days or hrs) and temperature the sample was exposed to (e.g., 5.5 days; 20C)

samp_transport_cont.name: samp_transport_cont
samp_transport_cont.description: Container in which the sample was stored during transport. Indicate the location name, e.g., bottle, cooler, glass vial, plastic vial, vendor supplied container

samp_transport_dur.name: samp_transport_dur
samp_transport_dur.description: The duration of time from when the sample was collected until processed. Indicate the duration for which the sample was stored written in ISO 8601 format

samp_transport_temp.name: samp_transport_temp
samp_transport_temp.description: Temperature at which sample was transported, e.g., -20 or 4 degree Celsius

samp_tvdss.name: samp_tvdss
samp_tvdss.description: Depth of the sample i.e. The vertical distance between the sea level and the sampled position in the subsurface. Depth can be reported as an interval for subsurface samples e.g., 1325.75-1362.25 m

samp_weather.name: samp_weather
samp_weather.description: The weather on the sampling day, e.g., clear sky, cloudy, foggy, hail, rain, snow, sleet, sunny, windy

samp_well_name.name: samp_well_name
samp_well_name.description: Name of the well where sample was taken, e.g., BXA1123

sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_1.name: sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_1
sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_1.description: The name of the gene used in the first diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test.

sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_2.name: sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_2
sars_cov_2_diag_gene_name_2.description: The name of the gene used in the second diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test.

sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_1.name: sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_1
sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_1.description: The cycle threshold (CT) value result from the first diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test, e.g., 21

sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_2.name: sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_2
sars_cov_2_diag_pcr_ct_value_2.description: The cycle threshold (CT) value result from the second diagnostic SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR test, e.g., 36

saturates_pc.name: saturates_pc
saturates_pc.description: Saturate, Aromatic, Resin and Asphaltene (SARA) is an analysis method that divides crude oil components according to their polarizability and polarity. There are three main methods to obtain SARA results. The most popular one is known as the Iatroscan TLC-FID and is referred to as IP-143 (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Saturate,_aromatic,_resin_and_asphaltene)

season.name: season
season.description: The season when sampling occurred. Any of the four periods into which the year is divided by the equinoxes and solstices. This field accepts terms listed under season (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C94729)

season_environment.name: season_environment
season_environment.description: treatment involving an exposure to a particular season (e.g. winter, summer, rabi, rainy etc.)

season_humidity.name: season_humidity
season_humidity.description: Average humidity of the region throughout the growing season

season_precpt.name: season_precpt
season_precpt.description: The average of all seasonal precipitation values known, or an estimated equivalent value derived by such methods as regional indexes or Isohyetal maps

season_use.name: season_use
season_use.description: The seasons the space is occupied, e.g., spring, summer, fall, winter

secondary_treatment.name: secondary_treatment
secondary_treatment.description: the process for substantially degrading the biological content of the sewage

sediment_type.name: sediment_type
sediment_type.description: information about the sediment type based on major constituents

sequenced_by.name: sequenced_by
sequenced_by.description: The name of the agency that generated the sequence, e.g., Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

serotype.name: serotype
serotype.description: Taxonomy below subspecies; a variety (in bacteria, fungi or virus) usually based on its antigenic properties. Same as serovar and serogroup. e.g. serotype="H1N1" in Influenza A virus CY098518.

serovar.name: serovar
serovar.description: Taxonomy below subspecies; a variety (in bacteria, fungi or virus) usually based on its antigenic properties. Same as serovar and serotype. Sometimes used as species identifier in bacteria with shaky taxonomy, e.g. Leptospira interrogans serovar Hardjo

serovar_or_serotype.name: serovar_or_serotype
serovar_or_serotype.description: A characterization of a cell or microorganism based on the antigenic properties of the molecules on its surface. Indicate the name of a serovar or serotype of interest. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy

sewage_type.name: sewage_type
sewage_type.description: type of wastewater treatment plant as municipial or industrial

sexual_act.name: sexual_act
sexual_act.description: current sexual partner and frequency of sex

shad_dev_water_mold.name: shad_dev_water_mold
shad_dev_water_mold.description: Signs of the presence of mold or mildew on the shading device, e.g., presence of mold visible, no presence of mold visible

shading_device_cond.name: shading_device_cond
shading_device_cond.description: The physical condition of the shading device at the time of sampling, e.g., damaged, needs repair, new, rupture, visible wear

shading_device_loc.name: shading_device_loc
shading_device_loc.description: The location of the shading device in relation to the built structure, e.g., exterior, interior

shading_device_mat.name: shading_device_mat
shading_device_mat.description: The material the shading device is composed of

shading_device_type.name: shading_device_type
shading_device_type.description: The type of shading device, e.g., bahama shutters, exterior roll blind, gambrel awning, hood awning, porchroller awning, sarasota shutters, slatted aluminum, solid aluminum awning, sun screen, tree, trellis, venetian awning

sieving.name: sieving
sieving.description: collection design of pooled samples and/or sieve size and amount of sample sieved

size_frac.name: size_frac
size_frac.description: Filtering pore size used in sample preparation, e.g., 0-0.22 micrometer

size_frac_low.name: size_frac_low
size_frac_low.description: Refers to the mesh/pore size used to pre-filter/pre-sort the sample. Materials larger than the size threshold are excluded from the sample

size_frac_up.name: size_frac_up
size_frac_up.description: Refers to the mesh/pore size used to retain the sample. Materials smaller than the size threshold are excluded from the sample

slope_aspect.name: slope_aspect
slope_aspect.description: the direction a slope faces. While looking down a slope use a compass to record the direction you are facing (direction or degrees); e.g., NW or 315°. This measure provides an indication of sun and wind exposure that will influence soil temperature and evapotranspiration.

slope_gradient.name: slope_gradient
slope_gradient.description: commonly called "slope". The angle between ground surface and a horizontal line (in percent). This is the direction that overland water would flow. This measure is usually taken with a hand level meter or clinometer.

sludge_retent_time.name: sludge_retent_time
sludge_retent_time.description: the time activated sludge remains in reactor

soil_conductivity.name: soil_conductivity
soil_conductivity.description: Conductivity of soil at time of sampling

soil_cover.name: soil_cover
soil_cover.description: Description of the material covering the sampled soil. This field accepts terms under ENVO:00010483, environmental material

soil_depth.name: soil_depth
soil_depth.description: The vertical distance below local surface, e.g., for sediment or soil samples depth is measured from sediment or soil surface, respectively. Depth can be reported as an interval for subsurface samples

soil_horizon.name: soil_horizon
soil_horizon.description: specific layer in the land area which measures parallel to the soil surface and possesses physical characteristics which differ from the layers above and beneath

soil_ph.name: soil_ph
soil_ph.description: The pH of soil at time of sampling

soil_porosity.name: soil_porosity
soil_porosity.description: Porosity of soil or deposited sediment is volume of voids divided by the total volume of sample

soil_temp.name: soil_temp
soil_temp.description: Temperature of soil at the time of sampling

soil_text_measure.name: soil_text_measure
soil_text_measure.description: the relative proportion of different grain sizes of mineral particles in a soil, as described using a standard system; express as % sand (50 um to 2 mm), silt (2 um to 50 um), and clay (<2 um) with textural name (e.g., silty clay loam) optional.

soil_texture_class.name: soil_texture_class
soil_texture_class.description: One of the 12 soil texture classes use to describe soil texture based on the relative proportion of different grain sizes of mineral particles [sand (50 um to 2 mm), silt (2 um to 50 um), and clay (<2 um)] in a soil, e.g., clay, clay loam, loam, loamy sand, sand, sandy clay, sandy clay loam, sandy loam, silt, silty clay, silty clay loam, silt loam

soil_texture_meth.name: soil_texture_meth
soil_texture_meth.description: reference or method used in determining soil texture

soil_type.name: soil_type
soil_type.description: soil series name or other lower-level classification

soil_type_meth.name: soil_type_meth
soil_type_meth.description: reference or method used in determining soil series name or other lower-level classification

solar_irradiance.name: solar_irradiance
solar_irradiance.description: the amount of solar energy that arrives at a specific area of a surface during a specific time interval

soluble_inorg_mat.name: soluble_inorg_mat
soluble_inorg_mat.description: concentration of substances such as ammonia, road-salt, sea-salt, cyanide, hydrogen sulfide, thiocyanates, thiosulfates, etc.

soluble_org_mat.name: soluble_org_mat
soluble_org_mat.description: concentration of substances such as urea, fruit sugars, soluble proteins, drugs, pharmaceuticals, etc.

source_material_id.name: source_material_id
source_material_id.description: unique identifier assigned to a material sample used for extracting nucleic acids, and subsequent sequencing. The identifier can refer either to the original material collected or to any derived sub-samples.

special_diet.name: special_diet
special_diet.description: Specification of special diet; can include multiple special diets. Enter one of the controlled terms.

specific.name: specific
specific.description: The building specifications, e.g., operation, as built, construction, bid, design, photos

specific_humidity.name: specific_humidity
specific_humidity.description: The mass of water vapour in a unit mass of moist air, usually expressed as grams of vapour per kilogram of air, or, in air conditioning, as grains per pound

specimen_voucher.name: specimen_voucher
specimen_voucher.description: Identifier for the physical specimen. Use format: "[<institution-code>:[<collection-code>:]]<specimen_id>", eg, "UAM:Mamm:52179". Intended as a reference to the physical specimen that remains after it was analyzed. If the specimen was destroyed in the process of analysis, electronic images (e-vouchers) are an adequate substitute for a physical voucher specimen. Ideally the specimens will be deposited in a curated museum, herbarium, or frozen tissue collection, but often they will remain in a personal or laboratory collection for some time before they are deposited in a curated collection. There are three forms of specimen_voucher qualifiers. If the text of the qualifier includes one or more colons it is a 'structured voucher'. Structured vouchers include institution-codes (and optional collection-codes) taken from a controlled vocabulary maintained by the INSDC that denotes the museum or herbarium collection where the specimen resides, please visit the INSDC website.

spikein_amr.name: spikein_amr
spikein_amr.description: Qualitative description of a microbial response to antimicrobial agents. Bacteria may be susceptible or resistant to a broad range of antibiotic drugs or drug classes, with several intermediate states or phases. This field accepts terms under antimicrobial phenotype (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ARO_3004299)

spikein_antibiotic.name: spikein_antibiotic
spikein_antibiotic.description: Antimicrobials used in research study to assess effects of exposure on microbiome of a specific site. Please list antimicrobial, common name and/or class and concentration used for spike-in

spikein_count.name: spikein_count
spikein_count.description: Total cell count of any organism (or group of organisms) per gram, volume or area of sample, should include name of organism followed by count. The method that was used for the enumeration (e.g., qPCR, atp, mpn, etc.) should also be provided, e.g., total prokaryotes; 3.5e7 cells per ml; qPCR

spikein_growth_med.name: spikein_growth_med
spikein_growth_med.description: A liquid or gel containing nutrients, salts, and other factors formulated to support the growth of microorganisms, cells, or plants (National Cancer Institute Thesaurus). A growth medium is a culture medium which has the disposition to encourage growth of particular bacteria to the exclusion of others in the same growth environment. In this case, list the culture medium used to propagate the spike-in bacteria during preparation of spike-in inoculum. This field accepts terms listed under microbiological culture medium. If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the spike in growth media

spikein_metal.name: spikein_metal
spikein_metal.description: Heavy metals used in research study to assess effects of exposure on microbiome of a specific site. Please list heavy metals and concentration used for spike-in

spikein_org.name: spikein_org
spikein_org.description: Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s). This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

spikein_serovar.name: spikein_serovar
spikein_serovar.description: Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s) at the serovar or serotype level. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

spikein_strain.name: spikein_strain
spikein_strain.description: Taxonomic information about the spike-in organism(s) at the strain level. This field accepts terms under organism (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C14250). This field also accepts identification numbers from NCBI under https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/taxonomy. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

sr_dep_env.name: sr_dep_env
sr_dep_env.description: Source rock depositional environment (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Source_rock), e.g., lacustine, fluvioldeltaic, fluviomarine, marine

sr_geol_age.name: sr_geol_age
sr_geol_age.description: Geological age of source rock (Additional info: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Period_(geology)), e.g., archean, cambrian, carboniferous, cenozoic, cretaceous, devonian, jurassic, mesozoic, neogene, ordovician, paleogene, paleozoic, permian, precambrian, proterozoic, silurian, triassic

sr_kerog_type.name: sr_kerog_type
sr_kerog_type.description: Origin of kerogen. Type I: Algal (aquatic), Type II: planktonic and soft plant material (aquatic or terrestrial), Type III: terrestrial woody/ fibrous plant material (terrestrial), Type IV: oxidized recycled woody debris (terrestrial) (additional information: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kerogen), e.g., type I, type II, type III, type IV

sr_lithology.name: sr_lithology
sr_lithology.description: Lithology of source rock (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Source_rock), e.g., clastic, carbonate, coal, biosilicieous

standing_water_regm.name: standing_water_regm
standing_water_regm.description: treatment involving an exposure to standing water during a plant's life span, types can be flood water or standing water; can include multiple regimens

ster_meth_samp_room.name: ster_meth_samp_room
ster_meth_samp_room.description: The method used to sterilize the sampling room. This field accepts terms listed under electromagnetic radiation (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_01001026). If the proper descriptor is not listed, please use text to describe the sampling room sterilization method. Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

store_cond.name: store_cond
store_cond.description: explain how and for how long the soil sample was stored before DNA extraction.

study_complt_stat.name: study_complt_stat
study_complt_stat.description: specification of study completion status, if no the reason should be specified

study_design.name: study_design
study_design.description: Epidemiological or omics reseach design context that this biosample was used in.

study_inc_dur.name: study_inc_dur
study_inc_dur.description: Sample incubation duration if unpublished or unvalidated method is used. Indicate the timepoint written in ISO 8601 format

study_inc_temp.name: study_inc_temp
study_inc_temp.description: Sample incubation temperature if unpublished or unvalidated method is used

study_timecourse.name: study_timecourse
study_timecourse.description: For time-course research studies involving samples of the food commodity, indicate the total duration of the time-course study

study_tmnt.name: study_tmnt
study_tmnt.description: A process in which the act is intended to modify or alter some other material entity. From the study design, each treatment is comprised of one level of one or multiple factors. This field accepts terms listed under treatment (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/MCO_0000866). If the proper descriptor is not listed please use text to describe the study treatment. Multiple terms can be separated by one or more pipes

subclone.name: subclone
subclone.description: Name for the derived clone or subculture from which the sample was taken.

subgroup.name: subgroup
subgroup.description: Taxonomy below subspecies; sometimes used in viruses to denote subgroups taken from a single isolate.

subject_is_affected.name: subject_is_affected
subject_is_affected.description: Case vs control status for the subject of this sample, for case-control studies

subspecf_gen_lin.name: subspecf_gen_lin
subspecf_gen_lin.description: Information about the genetic distinctness of the lineage (eg., biovar, serovar)

substrate.name: substrate
substrate.description: the growth substrate of the host

substructure_type.name: substructure_type
substructure_type.description: Substructure or under building is that largely hidden section of the building which is built off the foundations to the ground floor level. Enter one of the controlled terms.

subtype.name: subtype
subtype.description: Used as classifier in viruses (e.g. HIV type 1, Group M, Subtype A).

sulfate_fw.name: sulfate_fw
sulfate_fw.description: Original sulfate concentration in the hydrocarbon resource

super_population_code.name: super_population_code
super_population_code.description: The 3 letter super population abbreviation from the Coriell Institute indicating ancestry. Enter one of the controlled terms.

super_population_description.name: super_population_description
super_population_description.description: The full, unabbreviated super population descriptor from the Coriell Institute. Enter one of the controlled terms.

surf_air_cont.name: surf_air_cont
surf_air_cont.description: Contaminant identified on surface. Enter one of the controlled terms.

surf_humidity.name: surf_humidity
surf_humidity.description: surfaces: water activity as a function of air and material moisture

surf_material.name: surf_material
surf_material.description: Surface materials at the point of sampling. Enter one of the controlled terms.

surf_temp.name: surf_temp
surf_temp.description: temperature of the surface at the time of sampling

suspend_solids.name: suspend_solids
suspend_solids.description: concentration of substances including a wide variety of material, such as silt, decaying plant and animal matter, etc,; can include multiple substances

sym_life_cycle_type.name: sym_life_cycle_type
sym_life_cycle_type.description: Type of life cycle of the symbiotic host species (the thing being sampled). Simple life cycles occur within a single host, complex ones within multiple different hosts over the course of their normal life cycle, e.g., complex life cycle, simple life cycle

symbiont_host_role.name: symbiont_host_role
symbiont_host_role.description: Role of the host in the life cycle of the symbiotic organism, e.g., accidental, dead-end, definitive, intermediate, paratenic, reservoir, single host

tan.name: tan
tan.description: Total Acid Number (TAN) is a measurement of acidity that is determined by the amount of potassium hydroxide in milligrams that is needed to neutralize the acids in one gram of oil. It is an important quality measurement of crude oil. (source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Total_acid_number)

teleomorph.name: teleomorph
teleomorph.description: Genus and species of the sexual (fruiting) form of fungi - note that anamorph and teleomorph forms of the same taxon may have used taxonomic different names.

temp.name: temp
temp.description: temperature of the sample at time of sampling

temp_out.name: temp_out
temp_out.description: The recorded temperature value at sampling time outside

tertiary_treatment.name: tertiary_treatment
tertiary_treatment.description: the process providing a final treatment stage to raise the effluent quality before it is discharged to the receiving environment

tidal_stage.name: tidal_stage
tidal_stage.description: Stage of tide. Enter one of the controlled terms.

tillage.name: tillage
tillage.description: Note method(s) used for tilling. Enter one of the controlled terms.

time_last_toothbrush.name: time_last_toothbrush
time_last_toothbrush.description: specification of the time since last toothbrushing

time_since_last_wash.name: time_since_last_wash
time_since_last_wash.description: specification of the time since last wash

timepoint.name: timepoint
timepoint.description: Time point at which a sample or observation is made or taken from a biomaterial as measured from some reference point. Indicate the timepoint written in ISO 8601 format

tiss_cult_growth_med.name: tiss_cult_growth_med
tiss_cult_growth_med.description: description of plant tissue culture growth media used

tissue_lib.name: tissue_lib
tissue_lib.description: Formal identifier that points to source institute and tissue library identifier.

toluene.name: toluene
toluene.description: Concentration of toluene in the sample

tot_depth_water_col.name: tot_depth_water_col
tot_depth_water_col.description: measurement of total depth of water column

tot_diss_nitro.name: tot_diss_nitro
tot_diss_nitro.description: total dissolved nitrogen concentration, reported as nitrogen, measured by: total dissolved nitrogen = NH4 + NO3NO2 + dissolved organic nitrogen

tot_iron.name: tot_iron
tot_iron.description: Concentration of total iron in the sample

tot_mass.name: tot_mass
tot_mass.description: total mass of the host at collection, the unit depends on host

tot_n_meth.name: tot_n_meth
tot_n_meth.description: reference or method used in determining the total N

tot_nitro.name: tot_nitro
tot_nitro.description: total nitrogen concentration, calculated by: total nitrogen = total dissolved nitrogen + particulate nitrogen. Can also be measured without filtering, reported as nitrogen

tot_nitro_cont_meth.name: tot_nitro_cont_meth
tot_nitro_cont_meth.description: Reference or method used in determining the total nitrogen

tot_org_c_meth.name: tot_org_c_meth
tot_org_c_meth.description: reference or method used in determining total organic C

tot_org_carb.name: tot_org_carb
tot_org_carb.description: Definition for soil: total organic C content of the soil units of g C/kg soil. Definition otherwise: total organic carbon content

tot_phosp.name: tot_phosp
tot_phosp.description: total phosphorus concentration, calculated by: total phosphorus = total dissolved phosphorus + particulate phosphorus. Can also be measured without filtering, reported as phosphorus

tot_phosphate.name: tot_phosphate
tot_phosphate.description: total amount or concentration of phosphate

tot_sulfur.name: tot_sulfur
tot_sulfur.description: Concentration of total sulfur in the sample

train_line.name: train_line
train_line.description: The subway line name, e.g., red, green, orange

train_stat_loc.name: train_stat_loc
train_stat_loc.description: The train station collection location, e.g., south station above ground, south station underground, south station amtrak, forest hills, riverside

train_stop_loc.name: train_stop_loc
train_stop_loc.description: The train stop collection location, e.g., end, mid, downtown

travel_out_six_month.name: travel_out_six_month
synonyms: travel outside the country in last six months
travel_out_six_month.description: specification of the countries travelled in the last six months; can include multiple travels

trophic_level.name: trophic_level
trophic_level.description: Feeding position in food chain (eg., chemolithotroph). Enter one of the controlled terms.

tvdss_of_hcr_press.name: tvdss_of_hcr_press
tvdss_of_hcr_press.description: True vertical depth subsea (TVDSS) of the hydrocarbon resource where the original pressure was measured, e.g., 1578 m

tvdss_of_hcr_temp.name: tvdss_of_hcr_temp
tvdss_of_hcr_temp.description: True vertical depth subsea (TVDSS) of the hydrocarbon resource where the original temperature was measured, e.g., 1345 m

type_of_symbiosis.name: type_of_symbiosis
type_of_symbiosis.description: Type of biological interaction established between the symbiotic host organism being sampled and its respective host, e.g., commensalistic, mutualistic, parasitic

urine_collect_meth.name: urine_collect_meth
urine_collect_meth.description: Specification of urine collection method. Enter one of the controlled terms.

urogenit_disord.name: urogenit_disord
urogenit_disord.description: history of urogenital disorders, can include multiple disorders

urogenit_tract_disor.name: urogenit_tract_disor
urogenit_tract_disor.description: history of urogenitaltract disorders; can include multiple disorders

vaccine_received.name: vaccine_received
vaccine_received.description: Which vaccine did the host receive, e.g., Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine

ventilation_rate.name: ventilation_rate
ventilation_rate.description: ventilation rate of the system in the sampled premises

vfa.name: vfa
vfa.description: Concentration of Volatile Fatty Acids in the sample

vfa_fw.name: vfa_fw
vfa_fw.description: Original volatile fatty acid concentration in the hydrocarbon resource

virus_isolate_of_prior_infection.name: virus_isolate_of_prior_infection
virus_isolate_of_prior_infection.description: Specific isolate of SARS-CoV-2 in prior infection (if known), e.g., SARS-CoV-2/human/USA/CA-CDPH-001/2020

vis_media.name: vis_media
vis_media.description: The building visual media, e.g., photos, videos, commonly of the building, site context (adjacent buildings, vegetation, terrain, streets), interiors, equipment, 3D scans

viscosity.name: viscosity
viscosity.description: A measure of oil's resistance to gradual deformation by shear stress or tensile stress (e.g., 3.5 cp; 100C)

volatile_org_comp.name: volatile_org_comp
volatile_org_comp.description: concentration of carbon-based chemicals that easily evaporate at room temperature; can report multiple volatile organic compounds by entering numeric values preceded by name of compound

wall_area.name: wall_area
wall_area.description: The total area of the sampled room's walls

wall_const_type.name: wall_const_type
wall_const_type.description: The building class of the wall defined by the composition of the building elements and fire-resistance rating, e.g., frame construction, joisted masonry, light noncombustible, masonry noncombustible, modified fire resistive, fire resistive

wall_finish_mat.name: wall_finish_mat
wall_finish_mat.description: The material utilized to finish the outer most layer of the wall, e.g., plaster, gypsum plaster, veneer plaster, gypsum board, tile, terrazzo, stone facing, acoustical treatment, wood, metal, masonry

wall_height.name: wall_height
wall_height.description: The average height of the walls in the sampled room

wall_loc.name: wall_loc
wall_loc.description: The relative location of the wall within the room, e.g., north, south, east, west

wall_surf_treatment.name: wall_surf_treatment
wall_surf_treatment.description: The surface treatment of interior wall, e.g., painted, wall paper, no treatment, paneling, stucco, fabric

wall_texture.name: wall_texture
wall_texture.description: The feel, appearance, or consistency of a wall surface, e.g., crows feet, crows-foot stomp, double skip, hawk and trowel, knockdown, popcorn, orange peel, rosebud stomp, Santa-Fe texture, skip trowel, smooth, stomp knockdown, swirl

wall_thermal_mass.name: wall_thermal_mass
wall_thermal_mass.description: The ability of the wall to provide inertia against temperature fluctuations. Generally this means concrete or concrete block that is either exposed or covered only with paint

wall_water_mold.name: wall_water_mold
wall_water_mold.description: Signs of the presence of mold or mildew on a wall, e.g., presence of mold visible, no presence of mold visible

wastewater_type.name: wastewater_type
wastewater_type.description: the origin of wastewater such as human waste, rainfall, storm drains, etc.

water_content_soil_meth.name: water_content_soil_meth
water_content_soil_meth.description: reference or method used in determining the water content of soil

water_current.name: water_current
water_current.description: measurement of magnitude and direction of flow within a fluid

water_cut.name: water_cut
water_cut.description: Current amount of water (%) in a produced fluid stream; or the average of the combined streams

water_feat_size.name: water_feat_size
water_feat_size.description: The size of the water feature

water_feat_type.name: water_feat_type
water_feat_type.description: The type of water feature present within the building being sampled, e.g., fountain, pool, standing feature, stream, waterfall

water_frequency.name: water_frequency
water_frequency.description: Number of water delivery events within a given period of time

water_ph.name: water_ph
water_ph.description: The pH measurement of the sample, or liquid portion of sample, or aqueous phase of the fluid

water_prod_rate.name: water_prod_rate
water_prod_rate.description: Water production rates per well, e.g., 987 m3/day

water_source_adjac.name: water_source_adjac
water_source_adjac.description: Description of the environmental features that are adjacent to the farm water source. This field accepts terms under ecosystem (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_01001110) and human construction (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00000070). Multiple terms can be separated by pipes

water_source_shared.name: water_source_shared
water_source_shared.description: Other users sharing access to the same water source, e.g., multiple users, agricutural, multiple users, no sharing

water_temp_regm.name: water_temp_regm
water_temp_regm.description: information about treatment involving an exposure to water with varying degree of temperature; can include multiple regimens

watering_regm.name: watering_regm
watering_regm.description: information about treatment involving an exposure to watering frequencies; can include multiple regimens

weekday.name: weekday
weekday.description: The day of the week when sampling occurred, e.g., monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday

weight_loss_3_month.name: weight_loss_3_month
synonyms: weight loss in last three months
weight_loss_3_month.description: specification of weight loss in the last three months, if yes should be further specified to include amount of weight loss

win.name: win
win.description: A unique identifier of a well or wellbore. This is part of the Global Framework for Well Identification initiative which is compiled by the Professional Petroleum Data Management Association (PPDM) in an effort to improve well identification systems. (Supporting information: https://ppdm.org/ and http://dl.ppdm.org/dl/690)

wind_direction.name: wind_direction
wind_direction.description: wind direction is the direction from which a wind originates

wind_speed.name: wind_speed

SARS-CoV-2.cl.description: Use for SARS-CoV-2 samples that are relevant to public health. Required attributes include those considered useful for the rapid analysis and trace back of SARS-CoV-2 cases.

SARS-CoV-2.wwsurv.description: Use for SARS-CoV-2 wastewater surveillance samples that are relevant to public health. Required attributes include those considered useful for the rapid analysis and trace back of SARS-CoV-2 cases.

Microbe.description: Use for bacteria or other unicellular microbes when it is not appropriate or advantageous to use MIxS, Pathogen or Virus packages.

Model.organism.animal.description: Use for multicellular samples or cell lines derived from common laboratory model organisms, e.g., mouse, rat, Drosophila, worm, fish, frog, or large mammals including zoo and farm animals.

Metagenome.environmental.description: Use for metagenomic and environmental samples when it is not appropriate or advantageous to use MIxS packages.

Human.description: WARNING: Only use for human samples or cell lines that have no privacy concerns. For all studies involving human subjects, it is the submitter's responsibility to ensure that the information supplied protects participant privacy in accordance with all applicable laws, regulations and institutional policies. Make sure to remove any direct personal identifiers from your submission. If there are patient privacy concerns regarding making data fully public, please submit samples and data to Japanese Genotype-phenotype Archive (JGA) database. JGA has controlled access mechanisms and is an appropriate resource for hosting sensitive patient data. For samples isolated from humans use the Pathogen, Microbe or appropriate MIxS package.

Plant.description: Use for any plant sample or cell line.

Virus.description: Use for all virus samples not directly associated with disease. Viral pathogens should be submitted using the Pathogen: Clinical or host-associated pathogen package.

Beta-lactamase.description: Use for beta-lactamase gene transformants that have antibiotic resistance data.

Omics.description: Use for submission of functional genomics data to Genomic Expression Archive (GEA) and metabolomics data to MetaboBank.
